output.summary: An evergreen cycad endemic to South Africa and strongly associated with the Natal Drakensberg. Its form varies with habitat, from robust high-elevation plants with fire-scarred bases to dwarf, sometimes multi-trunked plants at lower elevations. Its lemon-coloured cones are densely woolly, and its seeds and their fleshy covering are poisonous.
output.edibilityNote: The seeds and fleshy covering are poisonous; toxins also occur at lower concentrations in the roots, stems and leaves.
